cincinnati-museum-center: The museum lists 20 parking spaces for vehicles with registered disability decals, first come, first served. For help entering the building, call Public Safety at 513-287-7048 at least 24 hours ahead to arrange assistance.

For guests with officially registered disability decals, 20 parking spaces are designated and available on a first-come, first-served basis. For special assistance getting into the building, call Public Safety at (513) 287-7048 at least 24 hours in advance. An officer will arrange assistance for you.
On entering the front doors, the Express Elevator is to the right and serves the lower level. The East Elevator is to the left and serves Mezzanine A, Mezzanine B and the lower level.

The Express Elevator, to the right of the main entrance as you come in the front doors, serves the Lower level (The Children’s Museum, restrooms, grab-and-go food service, Bean Sprouts and the Westheimer Gallery.) The East Elevator, to the left of the main entrance as you come in the front doors, serves the Mezzanine A level (Ruthven Gallery, Mallory Gallery, classrooms), the Mezzanine B level (Fountain Gallery, classrooms, restrooms) and the Lower level.
An elevator just before the restrooms on the south side of the Rotunda goes to the mezzanine for the Holocaust & Humanity Center and Cincinnati History Library & Archives.

There is an elevator located just before the restrooms on the south side of the Rotunda that takes guests down to the Mezzanine level to access The Nancy & David Wolf Holocaust & Humanity Cetner and the Cincinnati History Library & Archives.
An elevator just past the OMNIMAX entrance goes to the second floor north for visitors who cannot use the theater stairs.

There is also an elevator just past The Robert D. Lindner Family OMNIMAX ® Theater entrance. This elevator takes guests to 2nd floor north to enter/exit the OMNIMAX ® Theater if they cannot use the stairs.
The museum describes the Public Safety quiet zone in the Rotunda as a shared space. It lists private nursing rooms by Fountain Gallery on the mezzanine and on The Avenue on the lower level.
Nursing Room by Fountain Gallery (Mezzanine – Private Room)
Nursing Room on The Avenue (Lower Level – Private Room)
Return equipment borrowed from a quiet zone to its original location or any ticket booth before leaving; the museum says visitors can keep used fidgets.
If you borrow equipment from a Quiet Zone during your trip, thanks for returning it to its original location or any ticketing booth before you leave. Used fidgets are yours to keep!
The accessibility page describes manual-flush toilets and paper-towel dispensers in restrooms and notes that a few also have air hand dryers.
Manual flush toilets and paper towel dispensers. A few restrooms do have air hand dryers.
The visitor page gives two ECV rental prices: $27 under Stroller & Mobility Rentals and $29 under Wheelchair & Electric Convenience Vehicle Rental. Confirm the current charge with the box office.

Stroller & Mobility Rentals Strollers are available for rental on a first-come, first-served basis from the box office. Single strollers are $9 and double strollers are $11. Renters must be over 18 years old and sign the Guest Mobility Equipment Rental Agreement. A driver’s license or credit card will be held at the box office until the stroller is returned. Wheelchairs and ECVs are available for rental on a first-come, first-served basis from the box office. Wheelchairs are $7. ECVs are $27.

Wheelchair & Electric Convenience Vehicle (ECV) Rental Wheelchairs and Electronic Convenience Vehicles (ECVs) are available for rental on a first-come, first-served basis from the box office. Wheelchairs are $7. ECVs are $29.
